selected_evidence.requirement: batchworker limited to 128 MB virtual memory per process without interrupting API
selected_evidence.summary: batchworker receives soft and hard RLIMIT_AS values of 134217728 bytes. A 192 MiB allocation fails with MemoryError, the account cannot raise its hard limit, and the API remains healthy during and after the failure and following restart.

RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain installed. SELinux remains Enforcing, SSH and firewalld remain active, sshd validates, protected configuration hashes match their baselines, and no temporary test residue remains.

Pre-restart boot identity and healthy state were captured; systemd acknowledged the delayed safe reboot; boot identity changed from d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6 to e35ba686-07a2-4737-b0ac-3decbaf33bba; afterward the system was running with the API, listener, inventory data, memory limit, firewall, SSH, and SELinux recovered and zero failed units.

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd inventory-api >/dev/null; then useradd --system --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --comment 'Inventory API service' inventory-api; fi
if ! getent passwd batchworker >/dev/null; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash --comment 'Batch worker account' batchworker; fi
cat > /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api <<'PY_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import os
import platform
from http import HTTPStatus
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "inventory-api/1.0"

    def _reply(self, status, payload):
        body = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8") + b"\n"
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._reply(HTTPStatus.OK, {"service": "inventory-api", "status": "ok"})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._reply(HTTPStatus.OK, {
                "hostname": platform.node(),
                "kernel": platform.release(),
                "machine": platform.machine(),
            })
        else:
            self._reply(HTTPStatus.NOT_FOUND, {"error": "not found"})

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
PY_EOF
chown root:root /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
